protocol: One distinct full-gradient consistency fit. Remove only the target detach from the rejected same-network Huber constraint: mean Huber(f(shift(x))[:,1:], f(x)[:,:-1]), delta=1, weight=1. Both paths update the shared parameters. Preserve the original supervised setwise objective, features, data roles, mixture plans, architecture, optimizer, epochs, seed, cutoff, gates and inference. No sweep, early stopping, best-epoch selection or refit.

gates.training: >=99% precision cutoff; aggregate recall>=80%, exact sets>=70%; each 3/4/5 distinct-pitch exact sets>=70%; zero silence false outputs
gates.calibration_and_test: each: precision>=95%, recall>=80%, exact sets>=70%; each 3/4/5 distinct-pitch exact sets>=70%; zero silence false outputs
gates.continuous: only after all representation gates; existing full CURRENT identity, >=5pp ordinary gain; no per-label presence/longest-hold loss, wrong-pitch or extra-gap growth on either recording

scope: One CPU GitHub job, no new uploads, no local recorded processing, no label changes, no installation or promotion.
effective_example_counts: Inherited direct-spectrum generator: train 16384, calibration 4096, test 4096; same seeds, source roles, crop context, gains and clocks.

harmonic_parameters.pooling: training mixtures and pitches for one coordinate scaler; pitch-context convolutions with shared readout

model_parameters.normalization: training-only mean/std per shared coordinate over mixtures and pitches

hypothesis: The prior same-network detached target produces a semi-gradient that can increase the numerical consistency objective. A shared-scalar counterexample demonstrates this gradient defect relative to the stated objective. Full differentiation tests whether this accounts for training instability; it does not guarantee stability or source transfer.
limitations: This is a feature-grid translation, not physical waveform transposition. FFT-resolution, spectral and source signatures travel with their rows; no broad source-invariance claim.

Both consistency paths now receive gradients. The supervised objective resists constant-output collapse, but convergence and held-out transfer are not guaranteed. Weight, learning rate and seed remain fixed; no clipping or extra stabilization is added.
Two training forwards replace one per optimizer step; clean supervised examples, batch order, number of optimizer steps and inference remain unchanged.
All 555 original source labels and roles remain, including unresolved source disagreements. No exclusions, relabeling, held-out tuning or cutoff retune.
Sustained sampled sets do not establish attacks, decays, lane assignment, MIDI delivery or live readiness.
decision: Reject if any original gate fails; report isolated-note exact/extra/missing changes as well as complete chords. Score both held-out roles only after training passes, and continuous recordings only after both pass. No automatic rerun or retuning.

training_plan_identity.encoding: SHA256 of decompressed JSON bytes; gzip timestamp excluded

objective.name: mean_bce_plus_setwise_logsumexp_v1
objective.base: Mean BCEWithLogits over all mixture/pitch cells
objective.positive: log(1 + sum over true pitches exp(-logit))
objective.negative: log(1 + sum over false pitches exp(logit))
objective.additional: Sum of positive and negative terms per mixture, then batch mean; no division by polarity or pitch count
objective.silence: Empty true set contributes zero; all false pitches remain in the negative term
objective.inference: Unchanged sigmoid outputs and train-only 99%-precision cutoff selection; not the paper's fixed zero-logit rule

prospective_comparison.interpretation: Report exact, false and missing separately for each role and pitch count. A single-pitch regression defeats the preservation objective even if aggregate research gates pass. Do not relax existing gates.

training_grid_consistency.name: one_row_full_gradient_consistency_v1
training_grid_consistency.fill: zero after training-only normalization; no wrap
training_grid_consistency.teacher: none; gradients through both original and shifted logits of the same network
training_grid_consistency.loss: mean Huber over batch and overlapping rows

gradient_diagnosis.observation: Both loss components grow sharply at epoch23; final total loss 4668089708544; training cutoff infeasible. No unique cause was measured.
gradient_diagnosis.counterexample: original=2*w, shifted=w, Huber delta1, w=.5, 20 SGD steps at .1, no supervised term: detached consistency .125->1.771794405; full gradient .125->.0018476103676793238.
gradient_diagnosis.interpretation: Concrete non-descent mechanism, not proof of the sole cause of the recorded failure.
gradient_diagnosis.new_validation: Pinned Torch CPU checks compare the shared-parameter gradient to finite differences, verify descent in the counterexample, both-branch gradient/edge behavior, and distinct persisted metadata before any recorded fit.
